usedFor: D-iD creates animations and video translations, and HubSpot tracks the work as a deal after “New Animation” runs “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Animation” in D-iD, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new animation opens a deal, so creative work and sales sit in one pipeline.

watchOut: D-iD triggers are polling, and “Update Deal” needs the deal ID, so store that ID when “Create Deal” runs.
